name: Chuul
heading: Chuul Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races, DMs Guild, 2018 publication. This player conversion uses the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Source consulted is the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The extracted reading order places the Pincer continuation above the Chuul heading. It belongs to the adjacent Chuul trait column. The traits give AC 14 + Dexterity, even though the design notes propose a smaller natural armor bonus.

name: Cloaker
heading: Cloaker Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races, DMs Guild, 2018 publication. This player conversion uses the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Source consulted is the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The player traits omit Moan, Phantasms and Sunlight Sensitivity, which the design notes discuss. The build uses the trait list and includes the p. 7 restriction on natural weapons as monk bonus strikes. The odd-point damage split is a table ruling.

name: Cockatrice
heading: Cockatrice Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races, DMs Guild, 2018 publication. This player conversion uses the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Source consulted is the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: The trait mixes fatigue and exhaustion terminology. The build uses effective 2014 exhaustion levels and applies the explicit petrified outcome at six failures.

name: Couatl
heading: Couatl Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races, DMs Guild, 2018 publication. This player conversion uses the 2014 fifth-edition rules. Source consulted is the v2 text.
sourceDistinctions: Divine Mandate supplies an ordinary focus. The build applies the 2014 hand rule for somatic components and selects actions that need none.
